answer_1.quote: Opinion summarization aims to summarize opinions into concise summaries.

answer_2.quote: Opinion summarization systems predominantly use traditional metrics such as ROUGE and BERTSCORE for automatic evaluation...

answer_3.quote: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been utilized as reference-free evaluators for Natural Language Generation (NLG) outputs... We present OP-I-PROMPT and OP-PROMPTS tailored for opinion summary evaluation.

answer_4.quote: annotations were collected for a total of 13 abstractive summaries per product across 7 dimensions for 32 products from the Amazon test set... each summary was annotated by 3 raters for 7 dimensions
answer_4.guideline: Annotators received specific guidelines on how to penalize summaries based on fluency levels... Summaries should be penalized if they miss out on an aspect that was majorly being discussed in the reviews...
